scope: Structured raw-to-LeRobot DROID lineage for held-out episodes 21, 60, and 77
summary: All three real DROID SequenceExamples now have structured raw trajectory/recording paths, exact task and frame-count matches, hashed LeRobot source videos, and passing frame-level PSNR/dHash lineage across wrist plus a predeclared one-to-one exterior assignment.
evidence: Episode 21 maps to 1.0.1/AUTOLab/success/2023-07-14/Fri_Jul_14_16:55:45_2023 with swapped exterior assignment.
Episode 60 maps to 1.0.1/AUTOLab/success/2023-07-31/Mon_Jul_31_20:04:00_2023 with identity exterior assignment.
Episode 77 maps to 1.0.1/PennPAL/success/2023-04-29/Sat_Apr_29_20:28:46_2023 with swapped exterior assignment.
Across all nine selected stream comparisons, frame PSNR p05 is 33.201-36.297 dB and dHash Hamming p95 is 1-2 bits, passing frozen 25 dB and 8-bit gates.

The three LeRobot source MP4 SHA-256 values are ca8e4e013dbfd46b5a6c89df299aa806385e1ccd7733d88057a331085ab663bf, 6ef76cd3ee4b7da229339ff9d4cec03c05b750ce5857f8c0cfc38747815be3d3, and 92d4ed033f667ba871ef742338be1a2ebcd3405aa4121b7441afcf2d657f62da.
lessons: Raw DROID camera paths can be recovered structurally without printable-string heuristics.
Exterior stream lineage must preserve an explicit episode-local camera assignment rather than silently assuming name identity.
limitations: The official raw DROID license remains unresolved, so raw-data training and redistribution are still blocked.
Lineage does not establish novel-view generation quality or real physical task success.
next_actions: Use the recovered raw prefixes to retrieve calibration/depth for held-out episodes under internal audit only.
Keep camera assignments explicit in every geometry and novel-view record.
Resolve official raw-data rights before any claim-eligible raw-data training.
